# TRL-PARSE-0007: YAML alias expansion limit exceeded

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: PARSE
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Reduce aliases or raise the trusted-input expansion limit.

